title: 19 Dollar Fortnite Card
blurb: 'Nineteen dollar Fortnite card. Who wants it?' In January 2021 a TikToker called @mrblocku filmed himself in a car seat frantically waving a V-Bucks card at the camera, and the internet decided this was cinema. The choppy recording, the sped-up delivery and the total absence of context made it irresistible remix material; one popular edit bolted on PlayStation sound effects and a squeaky voice announcing 'no more Fortnite'. Half a decade later it remains the standard audio for any suspicious act of generosity. Accept nothing from anyone while this is playing.
origin: From @mrblocku's January 2021 TikTok waving a $19 Fortnite V-Bucks card.
